name: night-shift
summary: Bold, high-contrast statements on a near-black navy background with one warm gold accent. Each slide hits one idea in huge condensed capitals, like a billboard. Built for scroll-stopping hooks and blunt truths.

archetypes.name: hook
archetypes.description: Huge centred statement in capitals, one or two words in gold

archetypes.name: truth
archetypes.description: Short capital heading top-left with one supporting paragraph

archetypes.name: step
archetypes.description: Giant gold number then a short heading and one line

archetypes.name: cta
archetypes.description: Centred ask with the call to action as a gold button

hook_patterns: 'You're not losing leads to X, you're losing them to Y'
A painful number or moment agents recognise
tone: Blunt, confident, peer-to-peer. Short punchy sentences. Second person.
caption_style: Opens with a one-line restatement of the hook, 3-6 short lines of value, a direct question to drive comments, then the CTA. 1-2 emojis max. 5-8 niche hashtags at the end.
